class.name: CbProbe
class.brief_description: A line a motion throws along the look. The motion happens only if it finds something, and its effects can act on what it found.
class.description: A child of a [CbMotion] (one per motion; not for a While). When the motion would start, a line goes from the player's view along the look, up to [member range]. One that flies ([member travel] above 0) is a projectile: aimed at what is under the crosshair, it is traced tick by tick along its way, and takes hold of what it meets first (someone who steps into it, a door that closes in front of it); at nothing, it flies out its whole range, takes hold of nothing, moves nobody, and is gone when it gets there (the motion's use, cooldown and event happen; looks see [code]link_missed[/code]). One that does not fly holds at once on what is there; if it finds nothing, nothing happens: no cooldown, no use, no event. If it finds something (the world, a prop, another player), it flies there at [member travel], takes hold of that point, and from then the motion is on: its parameters hold and its [CbForce] and [CbLink] children act. An effect whose target is "what the probe found" acts on that body at that point; a direction "toward the target" points at it. The point stays on what it found: on a prop or a player it moves with them. When that is gone the motion ends. In conditions, [code]linked[/code] is true for a player whose probe is out. A [CbLinkLook] draws the line.

members.member: How far the line reaches, in metres.
The speed it flies at, in metres per second: it takes hold after distance / speed. 0: at once.
Under an item: the longest the line holds once it has taken hold (0: until it is let go). Under a [CbMotion], its [code]duration[/code] says it.
Under an item: what lets the line go, either of: using the item again, a jump. Under a [CbMotion], its [code]until[/code] says it.
The event said where and when the line takes hold, at the player, with what it holds as the other one ([code]grapple.hooked[/code]: a puff where the hook lands). A mod declares it.
